provenance.provider: Official Formula 1 historical timing archive, parsed with FastF1
provenance.selection: Each driver's two fastest valid Q3 laps, excluding pit-in/out, deleted and FastF1-inaccurate laps
provenance.lap_table_selection: Only accurate, non-deleted, non-pit-in/out laps for the two selected drivers; stints retain original lap ranges
provenance.time_origin: FastF1 LapStartDate reconstructed from official timing and telemetry alignment; approximate rather than an independently measured GPS crossing time
provenance.sample_policy: Native per-channel samples inside lap start/end; no resampling, timestamp clamping or time stretching
provenance.tyre_age: TyreLife is FastF1's lap-completion age; lap-start age is TyreLife minus one
provenance.fuel: Not publicly measured; same session phase is context, not evidence of equal fuel
provenance.traffic: Qualifying ahead-car intervals unavailable in this dataset; tow cannot be excluded
provenance.position: Official broadcast position stream, approximate; raw coordinate units preserved
